rules.name: The Dark Stage Rule
rules.body: Preserve the intentional dark palette across system color preferences.

rules.name: The Condensed Voice Rule
rules.body: Anton for headings; IBM Plex Sans for reading and interface.

rules.name: The Dock Clearance Rule
rules.body: Reserve document space for the fixed dock and its safe area.

dos: Do preserve content, supplied artwork, and interactions.
Do keep captions attached and rows open.
Do preserve keyboard focus and reduced-motion states.
donts: Do not restore the rejected light visual world.
Do not add rounded card grids or decorative shadows.
Do not generate replacement artwork to satisfy a plate-size gate.
